input.quote: 12.22 Notwithstanding any other provisions in this Paragraph 12, when the Equipped Capacity is expanded to six (6) times of Initial Equipped Capacity or three (3) years after the RFS date whichever comes first, any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation binding Teleglobe USA Inc. I reviewed the capacity provisions (§12, incl. 12.1–12.25), Use of Segment T (§11), and the transit/interconnection obligations (§§15–17): none requires us to source capacity, transit or interconnection solely from the other APCN 2 Parties, and §§12.20–12.22 expressly confirm each Party's freedom to deal with other Carriers "without any restrictions". §§15.2, 16.2 and 17.1–17.3 impose non-discriminatory access duties on the Terminal Parties, which run in our favour and are not flagged. The only "exclusive" language in the document is the "sole and exclusive remedy" wording in the dispute clause (§27.1), which is a remedies limitation, not a purchasing exclusivity, and is outside this rule. The clause set therefore meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on the customer); no redline is warranted.
